answer: A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in harbor, and mirror reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 182 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vine account. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
